primarySource.label: MICHELIN Guide Southwest 2026 — official press release, 31 Aug 2026
primarySource.note: Added by session 4d7b292f as the first-party primary source behind the LVCVA page. It confirms the ceremony was held at Fontainebleau Las Vegas, lists every starred and Recommended restaurant with its street address, and states the full Southwest selection is 64 restaurants across 24 cuisine types. The fifth starred restaurant, Monte, is in South Salt Lake, UTAH — not Las Vegas — which is why Las Vegas has 4 starred restaurants and 5 stars, not 5 starred restaurants.

rows.name: é by José Andrés
rows.hours: Tue–Sun, two seatings nightly at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM. CLOSED Monday.
rows.note: Intimate tasting-menu room; a prior logged session recorded that tickets release three months ahead, which is relevant for a February 2027 booking. Sun closure re-confirmed 2026-11-27 (session c88d116c): official page shows Mon & Sun Closed. Only 9 seats at a chef's counter inside Jaleo, third floor of The Cosmopolitan. Tickets are released THREE MONTHS in advance, with a waitlist — for a Feb 15–18 2027 stay that window is already open. Phone +1 702-698-7950, reserve@ebyjoseandres.com. No ticket price is published on the official site, so cost for two stays blank. CONTRADICTION RE-READ 2026-11-28 ON BOTH FIRST-PARTY PAGES: the operator's own site ebyjoseandres.com states twice (body and footer) 'Open Tuesday through Sunday with two shows per night, at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM', while The Cosmopolitan's official restaurant page states 'Tuesday to Saturday: 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM / Sunday: Closed'. Both readings are first-party and they disagree on Sunday only; Monday is closed in both. Confirm Sunday by phone (+1 702-698-7950) or reserve@ebyjoseandres.com before planning a Sunday seating.

rows.name: Anima by EDO
rows.hours: Dinner served nightly from 5:00 PM.
rows.priceNote: A prior session logged an $85/person anchor from the official site. VERIFIED official site: 'Anima Experience' tasting menu $85 per person, so $170 for two adults before tax, tip and wine pairings. The tasting runs ~2 to 2.5 hours and the entire table must participate. Vegetarian and vegan tastings available on request. Separate Monday special: two handmade pasta dishes plus one select bottle of wine for $65 (a table price, not per person).
rows.note: Recommended in the 2026 guide (listed, no star). Cheapest published tasting-menu total for two of all 24 listed restaurants. At The Gramercy, 9205 W Russell Rd #185 — off-Strip southwest, so it needs a car or rideshare rather than a Strip bus. RE-READ 2026-11-28: official site states 'Dinner. Served nightly · 5pm' and a Monday 'Pasta & Wine Night' of two handmade pasta dishes plus one select bottle for $65 (that $65 is a two-person bundle, not a per-person tasting price, so it is not used as the Cost-for-2 figure). Instagram @animabyedo is linked from the official site.
